english.title: Conspire to have custody / control a thing knowing it was a counterfeit currency note with intent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to have in your custody or under your control a thing which was and which you knew or believed to be a counterfeit of a currency note, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DETAILS..), intending to

(E)_[pass or tender it as genuine]_
(F)_[deliver it to another with the intent that the other or another should pass or tender it as genuine]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conspire with another / others
to have custody / control of a thing
which was and you knew / believed
to be a counterfeit currency note
intending to pass / tender it as genuine OR
deliver it to another to pass or tender it as genuine

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 16(3) of the Forgery and Counterfeiting Act 1981 provides that it is immaterial that a note is not in a fit state to be tendered or the making or counterfeiting of it finished or perfected.
(ii) See also offence wording H2140.
